data.one_liner: Dart implementation of Conflict-free Replicated Data Types (CRDTs).
data.what_it_does: Provides a storage‑agnostic CRDT framework with Hybrid Logical Clocks for conflict resolution. It includes an in‑memory MapCrdt and hooks for custom storage backends.
use_when: building local‑first apps that need offline sync
creating deterministic data stores for distributed systems
avoid_when: needing ready‑made UI widgets or a full state‑management solution
strengths: Zero external dependencies, runs on any Dart platform
Storage‑agnostic API allows swapping persistence layers
Built‑in HLC for consistent ordering across nodes
weaknesses: No built‑in persistence or UI components
Requires manual integration with storage backends
Limited documentation on advanced use cases
